serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: SkyShaper SaaS and PaaS offerings deliver secure cloud platforms that integrate governed data resources, project workspaces, secure data exchange, analytics and visualization tools, scalable computation, and collaboration capabilities, all administered through customizable role-based access control (RBAC) infrastructures that enforce granular delegation of control to authorized parties. Individual entities authorized to share confidential data sources solely direct which other parties have access; groups authorized by these entities to access data sources can configure the structure of user memberships and their workspaces; entities and groups can restrict the forms of data products exportable from the unified system; and users access system resources through multi-factor authentication without the ability to cross-stream files and data across different groups' workspaces. Workspaces incorporate suites of data management, statistical, analytic, machine learning, AI, and visualization applications. SkyShaper service models provide on-demand provisioning and commissioning of virtual computing enclaves in clouds with built-in security infrastructure that enforces access controls, monitoring, and disclosure protections according to RBAC structures configured to fulfill conditions of a body of data sharing agreements (e.g., data use agreements, business associated agreements) governing sophisticated bilateral and multilateral interactions between parties in communities of any size. SaaS/PaaS service models operate in single- and multi-cloud environments, available on Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and other cloud environments, including the SkyShaper IaaS cloud.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: SkyShaper SaaS model services support three integrated platforms: User-Platforms, Apps-Platforms, and Data-Platforms. User-Platforms provide secure logon and user management tools, along with options for web portals, communications, data transfers (e.g., APIs, desktop file exchange, data entry forms), document/report generation, and access to Apps-Platforms. Apps-Platforms supply collaborative workspaces with configuration tools, plus options for desktop-as-a-service, software, and elastic CPU and GPU resources to support research, analytics, AI, visualizations, web applications, office tools, and operational workloads. Data-Platforms provide data-as-a-service, storing confidential data with data management tools that enable selective sharing of data resources with Apps-Platforms. Compliance Officers assigned by relevant parties use SaaS tools to establish RBAC structures that govern groups' and users' access to data, applications, and project workspaces. While the core platform architecture remains consistent across deployments, organizations may configure individual services, tools, and support capabilities to meet their requirements.

SkyShaper PaaS model services provide managed environments for developing, deploying, and running applications, including preconfigured hosting for applications and datasets, scaling of application and storage resources to match workloads, and middleware services (e.g., messaging, authentication integration, API management, and monitoring).

SkyShaper IaaS model services provide a physical infrastructure that delivers CPU and GPU computing capacities, virtual servers, storage, networking, infrastructure security, backup and disaster recovery, and infrastructure monitoring. SkyShaper SaaS and PaaS model services configure and manage SkyShaper IaaS resources.

SkyShaper supports flexible cloud deployments, with SaaS and PaaS capable of combining resources and activities across multiple clouds (e.g., AWS, Azure, SkyShaper IaaS). Hybrid deployments support user activities through environments that integrate resources from multiple clouds with SaaS tools and RBAC structures aligned to meet parties' architectural, security, and operational requirements.
